what_happened: Held source found for the recalled Rabin citation: Thomas 1997 'Languages, Automata, and Logic' Theorem 6.20 (Rabin Tree Theorem, S2S decidable), Theorem 6.19 (MSO -> Muller tree automaton, effective), Theorem 6.18 (Rabin Basis Theorem, emptiness decidable + regular tree witness), plus the explicit countable-branching-into-binary-tree embedding in section 6.3. This closes dispatch item 3 for the main citation without a web fetch.

Report 866 finding 5 claims countability survives for the open modals by indexing witnesses by (walk, time, subformula). That claim is itself an instance of G1: the walks of the induced sub-digraph are uncountable, so the closure is not countable-to-countable. The repaired step 1 is state-indexed and does not extend to the open modals. Recorded as a correction rather than a blocker.

The two lemmas that repair G1 are already compiled in this repository and were simply not cited by report 03 section 1.3 step 1: PlusTruth.stab_state_only (line 332, box-dot truth depends on the world state alone) and PlusTruth.box_global (line 372, box truth is one bit per model), plus plusTruthAt_timeShift (line 264) and the compiled carrier normalisation plusValidZTime_iff_plusValidInt. G1 was a defect in the stated justification, not in the construction.

Task 870's stated hypothesis, 'directed paths between any two nodes are unique', may be strictly weaker than what report 03 section 1.2's step 4 actually consumes: that step uses the undirected tree path between two nodes and its unique sink, which needs the underlying undirected graph to be a forest. Flagged for task 870's plan so it states the oriented-forest hypothesis rather than only directed-path uniqueness.

FrameOver.IsRegular bundles TaskFrame.Saturation as a fourth field, so the compiled plus_invariance_of_isZTime requires BOTH frames to satisfy Saturation. This forced a reordering of the argument: the cover must be taken FIRST and the countable-model step run inside the oriented forest (whose induced sub-digraphs are again oriented forests, hence again satisfy Saturation), rather than report 03's order of countable model first, cover second.
